claim_verdicts.evidence: Scoped: "Register scoped services by calling AddScoped." Registration table: `Add{LIFETIME}<{SERVICE}, {IMPLEMENTATION}>()` and `Add{LIFETIME}<{IMPLEMENTATION}>()`. "Registering a service with only an implementation type is equivalent to registering that service with the same implementation and service type."

"Before C# 14, you add the this modifier to the first parameter of a static method to indicate that the method appears as a member of an instance of the parameter type." "Both forms of extensions must be defined inside a non-nested, nongeneric static class." Reworded claim and §3 now say "in the form Đơn Hàng uses" and "in a static class"; matches ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:10-12.

EF Core provider table: "PostgreSQL* | `.UseNpgsql(connectionString)` | Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL". DonHang.Infrastructure.csproj references Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL (10.0.3 per versions.yaml).

Reworded claim and §4 ("never fills a required constructor parameter with `null`") now carry the condition the docs set: "Constructors can accept arguments that aren't provided by dependency injection, but the arguments must assign default values." Throw half: r1 scratch app (net10.0) `Unable to resolve service for type 'Svc' while attempting to activate 'TController'.` No Đơn Hàng constructor declares a default.

"In the development environment when options haven't been set with UseDefaultServiceProvider, ValidateOnBuild and ValidateScopes are set to true." "Apps usually run in the Development environment during local development and testing on a developer's machine". Repo: STAGE.md "scripts/up.sh ... starts the lab"; up.sh runs `docker compose up -d --build --wait`; docker-compose.yml:93 `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: "Development"`. Program.cs has no UseDefaultServiceProvider. No launchSettings.json at stage-1.

claim_verdicts.evidence: "By default, ASP.NET Core doesn't register controllers as services in the DI container. The runtime uses the DefaultControllerActivator to create controller instances and resolves services from the DI container for constructor parameters". Scratch app, Development, Svc unregistered: `BUILD OK`, then GET → `InvalidOperationException ... activate 'TController'` → 500. ExceptionHandlingMiddleware.cs catch (Exception) writes 500 (InvalidOperationException is not KeyNotFound/Argument).

OrdersController.cs:12 `OrdersController(OrderService orderService, IOrderRepository repository)`; OrderService.cs `OrderService(IOrderRepository repository, INotifier notifier)`; ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:15 is the only IOrderRepository registration (git grep at stage-1). Scratch app: controller and Svc both resolved IRepo from one AddScoped line (GET → 200).

Follows from the code: the only INotifier registration is ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:16 and Program.cs names no notifier. Holds on the condition that the new class's constructor needs only types already registered (see minor issue on §7).

"The AddDbContext extension method registers DbContext types with a scoped lifetime by default." For "along with its settings": "The ApplicationDbContext class must expose a public constructor with a DbContextOptions<ApplicationDbContext> parameter. This is how context configuration from AddDbContext is passed to the DbContext."
